quadrature: Gauss-Legendre in N versus tanh-sinh in z=exp(N-N_end), segmented every two e-folds, independently transformed volume/dust/radiation kernels; coefficients factored for all a rows.
root: 360-step bisection on monotonic intervals; independent two-variable scalar-force/curvature-flux Newton solve at neighboring ratios.
shift_tolerance: 1e-48 for cancellation of input shifts through 1e40 at90 digits
normalization: abs(actual-expected)/max(1,abs(expected)); quadrature comparison uses ratio to preserve tiny integrals.
finite_epsilon_tolerance: 2*abs(epsilon) for secant slope compared with derivative at zero, separately exact symbolic and high-precision derivative controls.
negative_controls: Fixed-Lambda shift changes potential; nonconstant shift violates form equation; finite flux exceeds future ratio; additional constant vacua retained with Hessian signature. Independent implementation mutations requested after first run.
